item.text: Inspecting the treasury bulletin text to locate the most recent reporting date for currency and coin in circulation, then extracting the per capita dollar amount directly from the document.
`rg` is unavailable here, so I’m switching to `grep`/`sed` to find the specific circulation table and the latest per-capita figure.

item.command: /bin/bash -lc "grep -n -i \"per capita\\|currency and coin in circulation\\|coin in circulation\\|currency in circulation\" /mnt/data/LSF/data/officeqa/text/treasury_bulletin_2025_03.txt | head -n 200"

/bin/bash -lc "grep -n -i \"per capita\\|currency and coin in circulation\\|coin in circulation\\|currency in circulation\" /mnt/data/LSF/data/officeqa/text/treasury_bulletin_2025_03.txt | head -n 200"
